methodology.collider: radius-10 Solid circle, dynamic mass1; Actor layer1/mask2, terrain layer2/mask1
methodology.dense: 75% filled, one free corridor row per four rows
methodology.scattered: coordinate hash 1/8 occupancy except free corridors
methodology.movement: deterministic poses reset outside timed region each step, press 2 units into a floor; endpoint response, no Motion component
methodology.edits: 8 distinct floor image cells toggle Solid/null per dynamic step; no render subscriptions
methodology.phases: separate instrumented runs wrap internal methods with performance.now; query includes filtering/narrow phase/contact recording, response includes recompute/features/translation; delivery includes event handlers. Wrapper overhead affects profiled times. Plain Engine.step timings are not instrumented.
methodology.build: map time includes input Grid construction, initial Solid/floor inventory and Tilemap copied-grid validation; actor time includes components/subscriptions; first step includes registration/pair creation
methodology.percentiles: ordinary median and nearest-rank p95; raw samples retained

limitations: Shared Linux/Node JIT host; no browser/GPU/FPS or hardware guarantee
One map, static axis-aligned terrain and radius10 circles, masks intentionally exclude Actor/Actor response; existing Actor Solver has separate regression evidence
Phased timings are diagnostic instrumented observations, not zero-overhead production costs; components of profiled and plain runs must not be summed together
Pose resets keep comparable repeated endpoint penetrations; this is not a full game/session or CCD workload
Retained cell/pair counters are logical resources, not heap/native/GPU byte measurements; no long soak measured
The dense map contains free corridors; it is not a claim of recovery from arbitrary fully embedded terrain
